logo.label: Logo (light backgrounds)
logo.info: Leave empty to use the built-in Valoria London logo. SVG or PNG with a transparent background works best.

logo_inverse.label: Logo (dark backgrounds)
logo_inverse.info: Used in the footer. Leave empty to use the built-in white logo.

favicon.label: Favicon
favicon.info: Shown at 32 × 32 px. Leave empty to use the built-in Valoria favicon.

settings.graphite_info: Keep this dark enough to read on Paper (at least 4.5:1 contrast).
settings.accent_info: Use sparingly. A deep colour reads as luxury; bright colours cheapen the look.

use_house_fonts.label: Use the Valoria house fonts
use_house_fonts.info: Bodoni Moda for headings and Inter for text, built into the theme. Untick to use the fonts chosen below.

settings.animations: Enable subtle hover and reveal animations

settings.card_quick_add: Show add to bag on product cards

size_option_names.label: Size option names
size_option_names.info: Comma-separated variant option names that hold the bottle size. Used for the size shown on product cards.

free_delivery_threshold.label: Free delivery threshold
free_delivery_threshold.info: Shows a progress message in the cart. Set to 0 to hide. Only set this if you actually offer free delivery at this amount.

cart_delivery_note.label: Delivery note in cart
cart_delivery_note.info: Short, accurate note from your delivery policy. Leave empty to hide.

settings.paragraph: These short summaries appear on product pages and in the trust strip. Only enter what your published policies say.

delivery_summary.label: Delivery summary
delivery_summary.info: For example, your standard UK delivery time and cost.
